contracts.purpose: One ordered, bounded, exact-integer inertial cell update with a signed per-component momentum ledger and a separate non-negative speed-loss ledger (re-review finding 2).

contract.status: Proposed #212 contract model (tools/lcb/inertial_contract.py). Exact-integer worked examples of one cell update against a static neighbourhood; no World, scheduler or inertial family has executed.
contract.eligibility: Empty: any move. Lighter foreign liquid: only a move with dy = +1 (straight or diagonal down; Current can_density_exchange, vertical delta != 0). Wall, body mask, same family: never. One rule for support, re-aim, side selection and every travel move.
contract.deflection: s*d with d = trunc(vy_in * deflect); impulses (s*d, -vy_in); L1 loss |vx| + vy_in - |vx + s*d| (cancellation against an opposing vx included)
order: U1 support detection (below enterable?) before any velocity change
U2 gravity: vy += g exactly once
U3 supported cell: diagonal re-aim (A) if a diagonal is enterable; otherwise support cancels this tick's g, then blocked-fall deflection (B) of the vy carried in from earlier ticks
U5 per-component damping, truncated toward zero

U6 accumulator travel: whole-cell unit moves, target recheck each; a sub-step needing both axes is tried as one diagonal move first; a lighter liquid swaps with drag only on a move with dy = +1 (never horizontally); the first contact ends travel (vertical contact = rule B then saturation, horizontal = zero vx)
U7 rest: supported, vy == 0, |vx| <= rest -> vx = 0 and accumulators reset; sleep-eligible iff v == 0, a == 0 and supported

ledgers.momentum: per component: v_after = v_before + gravity + sum(signed impulses)
ledgers.speed_loss: L1: |v_after| = |v_before| + g - sum(loss); every non-gravity loss >= 0; support cancellation is a constraint, not dissipation
ledgers.rounding: products truncate toward zero; the signed remainder numerator is audited, never stored
